question: How should the wise planner arrange the dwellings of the eastern and other groups?
premises: The wise planner is responsible for arrangement.
Dwellings are to be arranged all around.
The arrangement proceeds from the east and other directions.
inference: The wise planner should arrange the dwellings of the eastern and other groups all around in order.
plain_english: The wise one should arrange the dwellings of those in the east and other directions all around.
